Search behavior can vary with the connected email provider.

sources.name: Detailed Missive user comparison on Reddit

claims.statement: Missive lets teams share an inbox, assign a message, add private comments, and prepare a reply together.
The free plan is limited to three users, two shared accounts, and 15 days of visible history.
Annual prices are $14 per user monthly for Starter, $24 for Productive, and $36 for Business. Monthly billing costs more.
Assignment and internal comments commonly reduce duplicate replies and lost context for teams working in the same inbox.
Search quality and speed are repeated complaints, especially for older messages and providers outside Gmail and Outlook.
The number of options creates a learning curve, while mobile read state and notifications can require adjustment.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A small team can connect one inbox and learn assignment quickly, but the sharing and notification choices take care.
scoreRationale.product: The collaboration tools solve a clear email problem. Search reliability and mobile friction keep it from being an easy recommendation for every team.
scoreRationale.support: Public feedback is generally positive, but support was not tested directly.
scoreRationale.billing: The per-user price is reasonable when it replaces forwarding, duplicate replies, and separate internal chat. It is hard to justify for people who work alone.
scoreRationale.overall: Missive is a strong shared email workspace for teams that truly collaborate in email, provided its search works with their account.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Large review platforms are strongly positive, but search complaints recur.
No hands-on search or mobile notification test was completed.
Search behavior depends in part on the connected provider.
